import copy
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path("/home/eileenspectremoon/loa-dev/loa-aleph")
BASE = "84b6d9d734ab68f3986ce6b969ea0fb6e577bad2"
BRANCH = "agent/src-001-blind-replay-harness-implementation-20260914"
MAIN = "c949ea5f39daef42d22ca2e4111164d63dffcbf1"
AUTH = "calibration/src-001/core-design-basis/AUTHORIZED-blind-src-001-replay-harness-implementation-20260914.md"
RECON = "docs/architecture/21-blind-src-001-replay-harness-implementation-reconciliation.md"


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip()


def tree(rev):
    result = {}
    for row in subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-tree", "-rz", rev], cwd=ROOT).split(b"\0"):
        if row:
            meta, name = row.split(b"\t", 1)
            result[name.decode()] = meta.decode()
    return result


assert git("branch", "--show-current") == BRANCH
assert git("remote", "get-url", "origin") in (
    "git@github.com:0xHoneyJar/loa-aleph.git",
    "https://github.com/0xHoneyJar/loa-aleph.git",
)
assert not git("status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all")
assert git("rev-parse", f"{BASE}^{{tree}}") == "ec802d9a5a9ac0910bcc1aca2cfec5394bc22092"
assert git("rev-parse", "main") == MAIN
assert git("rev-parse", "agent/src-001-blind-replay-harness-design-20260914") == BASE
assert git("rev-parse", f"{MAIN}^{{tree}}") == "8ced176e50da0d05070b164cfe725752df947d3f"
assert git("rev-parse", "--is-shallow-repository") == "false"
assert not git("replace", "-l")
assert not git("log", "--merges", "--format=%H", f"{BASE}..HEAD")
subprocess.run(["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", BASE, "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", MAIN, BASE], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--check", BASE, "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)

before, after = tree(BASE), tree("HEAD")
assert set(before) <= set(after)
changed = [p for p in before if before[p] != after[p]]
assert changed == ["core.manifest.json"]
added = sorted(set(after) - set(before))
for path in added:
    assert path in (AUTH, RECON) or path.startswith((
        "calibration/src-001/replay/protocol/",
        "calibration/src-001/replay/fixtures/",
        "calibration/src-001/replay/tests/",
    )), path
assert not (ROOT / "calibration/src-001/replay/attempts").exists()

original = json.loads(git("show", f"{BASE}:core.manifest.json"))
current = json.loads((ROOT / "core.manifest.json").read_text())
old_admin = original["files"]["repository_administration"]
new_admin = current["files"]["repository_administration"]
assert len(new_admin) == len(set(new_admin))
assert set(new_admin) - set(old_admin) == set(added)
assert set(old_admin) <= set(new_admin)
comparison = copy.deepcopy(current)
comparison["files"]["repository_administration"] = old_admin
assert comparison == original
assert current["core"]["run_format_version"] == "1.8.0-provisional"
for path in current["files"]["core"]:
    assert before[path] == after[path]
for paths in current["files"]["adapter"].values():
    for path in paths:
        assert before[path] == after[path]
runtime = [p for p in before if p.startswith("runtime-js/")]
assert all(before[p] == after[p] for p in runtime)
assert git("rev-parse", f"HEAD:{AUTH}") == "4a1375742984878fc7ab19e6bdbfe6c6768a2fbd"
authority = [
    ("PROPOSED-blind-src-001-replay-harness-design-20260914.md", "40370866bcdfd3c70941aac21298aaaae96fff6e"),
    ("ADOPTED-blind-src-001-replay-harness-design-20260914.md", "25d60b9ec93eaa187fbf16ccf23ab305e1a70e85"),
    ("ADOPTED-blind-src-001-replay-Q-R1-execution-policy-clarification-20260914.md", "fcd52d4e0f8638012986bc95d2c1560b12c92e3b"),
]
for name, blob in authority:
    path = f"calibration/src-001/core-design-basis/{name}"
    assert git("rev-parse", f"HEAD:{path}") == blob
proposal = ROOT / f"calibration/src-001/core-design-basis/{authority[0][0]}"
assert hashlib.sha256(proposal.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == "52e1f1bae4cbf91dbaf9699b69bad5885e37ce503db7fcb16ea2fe32a0e10ed8"
protected = {
    "agent/loa-adapter-release": ("b9e2db742a087b8ae659ec39e476ed5e240cfa1f", "f9daba8ba3e9b33e2895265a1427d61829a90722"),
    "refs/stash": ("e5b49e873d8a03fcd0d1b3bc65fc7c80cb8b6ce8", "a71318a42d8dca812f7d57161d21e4d3bc1b388b"),
}
for ref, (commit, digest) in protected.items():
    assert git("rev-parse", ref) == commit
    assert git("rev-parse", f"{ref}^{{tree}}") == digest
saved = json.loads(pathlib.Path("/tmp/SYNTHETIC-src001-compatibility-011.json").read_text())
worktrees = git("worktree", "list", "--porcelain").split("\n\n")
assert worktrees[1:] == saved["preserved_worktree_registrations"]

report = {
    "format": "src001-producer-publication-proof/v1",
    "verification_command": ["python3", str(pathlib.Path(__file__)), sys.argv[1]],
    "verification_source": pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "verification_source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "repository": "0xHoneyJar/loa-aleph",
    "branch": BRANCH,
    "base_commit": BASE,
    "base_tree": git("rev-parse", f"{BASE}^{{tree}}"),
    "subject_commit": git("rev-parse", "HEAD"),
    "subject_tree": git("rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"),
    "canonical_main": MAIN,
    "working_tree": "clean",
    "authority_blobs": "unchanged",
    "authorization_blob": git("rev-parse", f"HEAD:{AUTH}"),
    "unchanged_preexisting_paths": str(len(before) - 1),
    "preexisting_changed_paths": changed,
    "manifest_change": "repository_administration additions only",
    "new_path_inventory": [{"path": p, "git_entry": after[p]} for p in added],
    "core_paths_unchanged": str(len(current["files"]["core"])),
    "adapter_paths_unchanged": {k: str(len(v)) for k, v in current["files"]["adapter"].items()},
    "runtime_paths_unchanged": str(len(runtime)),
    "run_format": current["core"]["run_format_version"],
    "generic_package_and_retained_run_pins": "exact mode/blob equality",
    "protected_refs": protected,
    "preserved_worktree_registrations": worktrees[1:],
    "new_aleph_capabilities": "0",
    "public_commands_added": "0",
    "real_replay_attempt_directories": "0",
    "intent_fidelity": "not begun",
    "merges": "0",
    "result": "PASS",
}
destination = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
with destination.open("x") as handle:
    handle.write(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ("subject_commit", "subject_tree", "unchanged_preexisting_paths", "core_paths_unchanged", "runtime_paths_unchanged", "result")}))
